name: templates-live-reload
body: Templates live reload: while `kalide start` runs, changes to the RESOLVED library's structure — its `library.yaml` and anything under its `slides/`, `sections/`, `themes/` and `media/` (the configured `templates:` path when set, otherwise the local `templates/`; see external-template-library, templates-dir-layout) — are detected like deck changes; the resolved library is re-validated, templates/themes reloaded, the deck re-validated and re-rendered, and the browser reloads (or shows the full-page templates error). Carve-out: this covers the resolved library's structure only — any other top-level entry in the library root (e.g. `.git/`, a README) is not part of the library and is ignored (templates-dir-layout). A change to the configured `templates:` value itself in `kalide.yaml` is NOT a live retarget: it stops serving and shows the full-page restart-required error (see template-retarget-requires-restart).
